verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee documents automations through CLI cron schedules and JS scenarios, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack shows that a user's automations can be versioned, reviewed, or rolled back. The only versioning evidence is the API's own path versioning (/api/v1) and its deprecation notices, which is an adjacent platform concern and not versioning of user automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
